Hi Sara — thanks, glad the benchmarks were useful. I put together a short options sheet that maps the uptime tiers to per-token blends, service-credit tables, and response windows. See attached: SLA-Pricing-Options.pdf.

Quick highlights:
- 99.5%: baseline per-token price, standard support (8x5 triage), service credit 5% of monthly invoice for breach.
- 99.9%: ~8% uplift to per-token price, 24/7 on-call for P1 with 4 hour response, service credit 10%.
- 99.95%: ~18% uplift, 1 hour P1 response, named escalation roster + quarterly on-site review, service credit 20%.

For committed 12‑month spends we typically offer a volume discount that scales with commit band: 5% at $250k ARR, 10% at $750k, 15% above $1.5M. We can apply the commit discount on top of the uptime uplift (i.e., net price = uplifted price * (1 - commit_discount)).

I included a recommended onboarding credit (one-time) for pilot customers: $15k onboarding credit for pilots converting to a 12‑month commit above $250k. The Mutual Action Plan is attached as an editable spreadsheet.

If you want, I can propose a refined counter-offer that tightens the ramp for the 99.95 tier while adjusting the commit band to align with your expected consumption profile.

Cheers,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
